description: Price-PREFERENCE slice. Isolates the composite score's `economic` weight, which the main 60-query set cannot observe: every economic query there carries a hard threshold (max_price/min_price), so all in-budget hotels tie at grade 2 and a profile with economic=0.000 scores identically to one with 0.200. These queries use graded ladders (evaluation/gold.py) so returning the cheapest or most premium qualifying hotels first scores higher than returning merely acceptable ones. Cut points are absolute LKR, frozen from the expanded and deduplicated 2026-09-15 Colombo snapshot (77 hotels, 52 priced), rather than derived at evaluation time from the candidate pool. Cheap and premium requests each have 14 grade-2, 19 grade-1, and 19 grade-0 hotels. The 20 questions balance ten cheap and ten premium requests; price-plus-rating questions are the only mixed constraints so every gold condition is explicit.
